column5: Project-wide orchestration planning closed 2026-08-31: 40 physical objects map to 29 atomic jobs and 5 views-not-jobs, but all jobs are fail-closed BLOCKED because full-rebuild/entrypoint/dynamic-as-of/runtime evidence does not establish an automatic schedule.
